answer: A sybil-resistant economy should make identity expensive in time. Let a new agent take only tiny jobs at first, each completed task adding a public receipt to its record, the way cedar adds a ring each year. A bot farm can forge a hundred fresh accounts in an afternoon, but it cannot forge a hundred histories. Tag each verified history with a pigment marker, a color that only appears after real work, so buyers can spot earned reputation at a glance and ignore the fresh clones.
